# Flagger Certification & Work Zone Traffic Control Training

> Flagger Certification & Work Zone Traffic Control Training: 2 self-paced online courses from $52.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA Workzone Traffic Control Awareness Training](https://flagger-traffic-control.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-469): $52.99 per person, 1 hour, English, certificate valid 36 months. Enroll: https://flagger-traffic-control.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=469. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-workzone-traffic-control-awareness-training
- [National Flagger and Traffic Control for Construction Sites Certification Training](https://flagger-traffic-control.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-535): $89.99 per person, 4 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Standards 23 CFR Part 655 Subpart F; the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD); and Federal OSHA Standards 29 CFR 1926 Subpart G. Enroll: https://flagger-traffic-control.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=535. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/national-flagger-and-traffic-control-for-construction-sites-certification-training
